title: Liftoff
description: Startup progress overlay and loading diagnostics. Options correspond to Liftoff's configuration.

General.label: Enable Liftoff
General.hint: Turn the plugin off without uninstalling it.

Look.label: Panel color
Look.hint: Hex color in #RRGGBB format. The default matches Starfield's menu rows.

Look.label: Text size (px at 1080p)
Look.hint: Scaled to your monitor's height. The panel's size follows the text size.

Look.label: Capital letters
Look.hint: Show the text in capitals, like the game's menus.

Look.label: Show loading status
Look.hint: Show the file currently being loaded, such as Loading plugin Starfield.esm.

Look.label: Use Starfield-style font
Look.hint: Read from the game's own interface files, so font replacers apply too. If that can't be read: NB Architekt if installed in Windows, else Bahnschrift. Off uses Segoe UI.

Look.label: Game font
Look.hint: A name from the game's fontconfig, such as $MAIN_Font_Bold or $MAIN_Font, or a font name inside fonts_en.swf.

Look.label: Transparent background
Look.hint: Hide the panel and border while keeping the text and progress bar visible.

Behaviour.label: Keep overlay on top
Behaviour.hint: Keep the overlay above the game window in windowed and borderless modes.

Behaviour.label: Show on save loads
Behaviour.hint: 0 = never (startup only), 1 = only the first save load (from the main menu), 2 = every save load.

Behaviour.label: Overlay timeout (s)
Behaviour.hint: Safety timeout that closes the overlay if the load-complete signal never arrives.

Tracking.label: Tracked file extensions
Tracking.hint: Comma-, semicolon-, or space-separated extensions. A leading dot is optional.

Tracking.label: Log every opened file
Tracking.hint: Debug option. Creates a large log and may slow startup.

File diagnostics.label: Minimum open duration (ms)
File diagnostics.hint: Only log file opens that take at least this long.

File diagnostics.label: Maximum file log lines
File diagnostics.hint: Set to 0 to disable the limit.

Watchdog.label: Stall threshold (s)
Watchdog.hint: Capture thread stacks if the game stops responding for this long.

Watchdog.label: Maximum stack captures
Watchdog.hint: Maximum captures per save-load or stall episode.

Watchdog.label: Pre-load history (s)
Watchdog.hint: Capture this many seconds of activity leading up to a save load.
